name.description: Visual display name of the item.

description.description: Flavour/lore text rendered in the inventory card.

value.description: Gold purchase value. Reselling fetches half value by default.

slot.description: The equipment slot KIND this item occupies — one of the kinds declared in rules.playerDefaults.equipmentSlots (the demo: head, necklace, body, hand, ring), not one of the slot ids. Which slot of that kind the item lands in is decided when it is equipped: an empty one first, otherwise the one holding the same item type. Omit on a Weapon or Spell — the type already means "hand".

story.description: Declares this item a story book. The chapters are the story's full authored text, in telling order; which of them the player has HEARD is state, granted one at a time by grant_chapter actions (the first grant also puts the book in the pack). Using the book replays the heard chapters into the narrative log. A story book should be type Special so the story can't be sold away.

id.description: The chapter id grant_chapter actions and { story, chapter } conditions reference.

text.description: The chapter as the book retells it — one narrator log entry.

attributes.description: Custom parameter extensions depending on item type.

attackAttribute.description: Attribute added to this weapon/spell's hit rolls (e.g. "strength", "intelligence"). The attacker's value applies — player or enemy.

damageRoll.description: Damage formula: Standard NdF[+/-M] (e.g. '1d6+1') or range (e.g. '1-4').

damageAttribute.description: Attribute added to this weapon/spell's damage rolls (e.g. "intelligence"). The wielder's value applies — player or enemy.

targets.description: Multi-target attack: one hit roll compared against each target's AC, every enemy caught taking its own damage roll. "all" strikes every living enemy with one click; an integer splashes from the enemy the player attacks — the blast centers on them and catches neighbours in encounter order, up to that many. Omit for a single-target attack.

grantsSpells.description: Item IDs of Spell items this item grants while equipped. A granted spell is castable without occupying a hand, and leaves the attack list on unequip. Its charges are the spell's own — a spell granted by two sources still draws from one pool.

armorClassBonus.description: Flat AC protection added when equipped. Used for Armor.

attributeBonuses.description: Attribute deltas applied while equipped and removed on unequip (e.g. { "perception": 1 }). Keys must be declared attributes.

healingAmount.description: HP restored on consumption. Supports flat numbers or dice notation.

teleportScene.description: Scene ID to teleport to upon usage. Used for consumable items.

actionPoints.description: Action Points (AP) required to swing/equip/use inside combat.

uses.description: Rest-limited uses (simplified spell slots): the item can be used at most max times between rests. Omit for an unlimited item.

refresh.description: The rest that restores the uses. A full rest always restores everything; "short_rest" additionally restores them on a short rest. Defaults to "full_rest".

reputation.description: Reputation value. Contributes to player's reputation upon acquisition and museum's reputation when placed in display cases.
